title: Fixed Interleaved Opposed Return Stair Bay
description: One complete newly authored static interleaved-return stair bay. Four whole thin stepped flights occupy two side lanes at two vertical levels within the same four-column frame. An ochre route starts at the front-left, rises rearward to its own rear intermediate landing, then returns forward on the upper right. A blue route starts at the rear-right, rises forward to a separate front intermediate landing, then returns rearward on the upper left. The opposite-end mid-landings never form one common branching landing; same-lane upper and lower flights retain a real three-metre vertical offset and open air beneath their thin sloping undersides. Full upper terminal landings, ground entry bands and complete flight/outer landing rails belong to the same whole module. This is not two copies of the old grounded solid half-turn stair stacked, nor extra upper branches on a shared T landing. All step profiles, thin supports, fixed placements and coordinates newly authored; no old stair mesh imported. Three opaque PBR roles, metres Z-up and full horizontal-bounds-centred grounded entry bands. One architectural model zero scenes. Route colours are only visual guides, not wayfinding signage. No host floors or fire-separating enclosure, human occupancy, walkability, headroom certification, emergency-egress/fire design, building-code/accessibility compliance, load, installation, engineering or safety capability. Rigging, animation and interaction not made or verified.
